Episode 183. Preliminary Battle Starting from Within (1)
Sword's Tomb.
Huphester named the castle that started to be built in the Sword Garden as such.
Huphester's newsletters were incessantly praising Rosa's divine power building the castle and the state of chaos.
The temporary alliance was continuously holding strategy meetings and collecting information about the Sword's Tomb. Orgal was scouting the vicinity of the Sword Garden daily through the steel gate.
"From the exterior, it seems... already completed? Such a massive castle? The first report came in only two days ago!”
"Can she wield such level of power even without recovering the power distributed to the 4th flagbearer? Indeed, a god is a god."
Octavia and Veradin spoke. Others in the room were also visibly shocked.
It was natural since a castle much larger than the old palace of Vermont was completed in just a few days.
It was also completely unexpected.
The only remaining problems for the temporary alliance were the halted construction of the warship Ram and the injured Rosa.
A super-large castle of a scale never before seen in human history was not even a problem to consider.
For a while, there was talk about the castle.
Why did Rosa build a castle, what she wanted to gain from it, and whether the alliance’s power could break through the castle made of soul energy.
Of course, nothing could be definitively concluded.
However, there was a mainstream opinion about the 'purpose' for which Rosa built the castle.
"To me, it seems like a measure to recover from the damage caused by the 4th flagbearer's death. A sort of display. She is saying that she still has this much power."
Kadun's words were nodded at by Lionel.
"I think so too. The castle was completed so quickly, but the construction of the warship Ram, which truly symbolizes the power and divine power of the deity, is still halted."
"A display..."
As Jin opened his mouth, people’s eyes gathered on him.
Jin had a very haggard face, different from the first meeting. His eyes were black, hair was dry, and his face was pale.
It was because of nightmares.
Since Rosa began building the castle, Jin had been suffering from severe nightmares every day. Nightmares involving Rosa.
It was not a nightmare stemming from psychological pressure or anxiety.
Rosa's power and will were directly penetrating into Jin's inner self. Just like Gliek in the white stone had devastated Dante's inner self.
Therefore, Jin was fighting against Rosa's will every time he fell asleep.
No, even when he was awake, he felt her influence every single moment.
The alliance and the comrades also knew that fact. The final battle had not yet begun, but in a way, the 'preliminary battle within' had already started between Jin and Rosa.
"Rosa doesn't need such a thing."
It was a heavy statement.
After the first full-scale attack, Jin was the only one in the temporary alliance who had 'directly' felt Rosa's power.
So, to Jin's eyes, Kadun seemed ridiculous for going on about the display.
"So what do you think? The 12th flagbearer."
"Just like the name of the castle, it seems she just built a grand tomb. A tomb where I will be buried."
There was silence for about ten seconds.
Jin slowly looked around at his allies and comrades.
Their eyes were filled with anxiety as they looked at Jin.
Jin was the only one to oppose Rosa.
It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that everything depended on the one-on-one match between him and Rosa.
So, it was natural to worry, as Jin, before even starting to fight, was getting haggard day by day, being oppressed by Rosa's aura.
[Considering the obsession she has shown you so far, that might be the case.]
When Orgal opened his mouth, Jin nodded.
"There's no chance to analyze the structure of the castle or verify the internal power. One battle, one result. That will determine our... no, the world's survival."
Jin stood up from his place.
"In a fortnight."
[A fortnight?]

"We attack the Sword Garden then. Until then, I will prepare to overcome Rosa's nightmares and be in the best shape to fight. The temporary alliance just needs to finish preparing for the battle during that time."
"What if you can't overcome Rosa's nightmares by then?"

"In that case, we'll have to postpone the date. There's no way I can win in this state. You're asking an obvious question, Veradin. On the contrary, if I push back Rosa's aura sooner and return to my original state, we will start the invasion immediately."
"Meaning we can depart even tomorrow if needed. Got it, we'll prepare. Does Kinzelo agree?"
[I agree.]
"Until the final battle, can I only participate in these meetings if there's something I absolutely need to hear?"
It meant that he would focus on improving his condition. Overcoming the nightmares even an hour earlier was much more important than Jin attending the meetings in person.
"Do as you wish. The details of the strategy will continue to be communicated, so speak up if you have any opinions."
After that day, Jin spent his time in the Secret Garden.
There was no better place to end the inner war against Rosa's aura without worrying about anything else.
The comrades who came with him to the Secret Garden were Gilly, Valeria, and Kwal. In the quiet and cold space, Jin spent much time sitting in a cross-legged position and meditating.
Invisible to others, a fierce battle was unfolding every moment inside Jin.
When he opened his eyes, Rosa's voice tore through his mind, and when he closed his eyes, Rosa's sword flooded into his heart.
When he slept, he dreamt of Rosa killing him and his precious people, and Jin could only watch helplessly. He was desperately distinguishing whether this was reality or a dream.
Therefore, the method Jin chose was to minimize sleep and meditate. There was no other way to resist Rosa's mental attacks.
'She must know she can't do anything to me with these tricks.'
'You've come quite far for such a thing, son.'
'I admit it's effective. But if I win this fight, it seems like you wouldn't be without loss either.'
'Well... if I have anything left to lose, it would be you. You are my last remaining pleasure.'
Others couldn't hear the conversation that continued inside Jin. Instead, Jin conveyed the contents to his frustrated comrades.
Peekaboo.
A group of small people peeked their heads at the entrance of the training ground, looking at Jin.
They were leaders of the Gumpaeng clan and members of the Water Tail tribe.
"Looks hard, Jin. Dying, no good."
"Oh, what's dying! Hmm, you do look pale as if you're sick. You seem dehydrated but why are you sweating like that? And you keep moaning, it's annoying."
Dark Flame and Paengi spoke with concern.
"Don't you need some sort of tonic?"
"We have, eel. Give? Jin. Strength, comes, if eat."
"Is that enough? Huh? Hey, they say the Secret Garden is full of elixir. Why isn't the leader taking out any? Don't tell me you're saving it for this crisis?!"
"No, things like elixir are of no use."
At the sudden voice of Syris, Paengi shut his mouth.
Before they knew it, Syris was also peeking at Jin like the little people.
"Euh, you startled me. I wasn't badmouthing you or anything, right? Leader. I was just worried about Jin. Haha."
"Right, Paengi, badmouthed."
"That one only speaks correctly when it's like this!"
Syris ruffled the little people's hair and put his index finger to his lips. It meant to be quiet, so as not to disturb Jin's meditation.
Every day was like that. Jin was meditating, and his comrades were observing him from a distance, being cautious. It was like a family being cautious around someone who has a big exam coming up.
One day, Syris was the first to ask Jin a question.
"Jin, you could use my mother's private training ground. Why do you insist on using the public one?"
"Because it's slightly better to feel the presence of the people close to me."
Syris was taken aback by the unexpected answer and locked eyes with Jin.
"Resisting the mental attacks of the curse?"

"Yes, knowing that comrades are nearby often serves as a checkpoint. When my ego is being submerged due to combating Rosa's mental attacks, hearing a sudden voice, footsteps, or a cough from a comrade snaps me back to reality."
"So, you mean you need a suitable level of familiar noise."
"Exactly, Sir Syris. If the environment is too noisy, I wouldn't be able to concentrate on the mental attack."
"I still find it hard to believe that a person as strong as you can be so disturbed by just mental attacks."

"Simply... it feels like I've been plunged into the deep sea with my hands and feet tied, and as I go deeper, I see the corpses of people I cherish. The fear within the boundary of reality and mental attack continues 24/7."
"…That's seriously grim. Is it getting better bit by bit?"
Syris asked carefully once again.
Jin's face looked much worse than the day he first arrived in Hidden Palace.
"Honestly, I'm not sure. And... when the time comes to completely end the mental attack, I will need the private training ground."
"So, you mean there's a moment when you need to fight alone."
"Yes, it's just my intuition, but I'm sure that will be the case."
For his comrades including Syris, it was frustrating. Even before the temporary alliance started the full-scale attack, Jin was already fighting a difficult and lonely battle.
So all they could do was vaguely imagine the battle Jin was going through and cheer him on.
However, a week and a half after Jin arrived at Hidden Palace,
Rosa's mental attacks started to affect his comrades, and key figures in the temporary alliance.
The first to experience the same kind of nightmare as Jin was Syris himself.
"Ahhhh!"
"Lord Hidden Palace!"
"Captain!"
When Syris's scream was heard, the 7 swords of Hidden Palace and the guards rushed into the chamber of Hidden Palace.
They saw Syris shaking, his body soaked with sweat.
It was the first time for all of them to see Syris in such a state of fear.

In his childhood, even when he woke up from a nightmare, Syris would calmly regulate his breath and close his eyes again. He was Syris who never showed a painful face even during the severe training as the Lord of Hidden Palace.
"Captain, are you okay?"
"Heuk, Heuk... Jin, Jin is..."
"Lord Hidden Palace?"
"Was he... enduring this every day?"
Syris said, and for a while, he could do nothing but lose his soul.
In the midst of the paralyzing fear of the curse called Rosa, an unbearable sense of sympathy for Jin surged.
